en.abdullah-al-shahin: (36) Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Sa’eed narrated from al-Qassim bin Muhammad bin al-Hasan bin Hazim from Obayss bin Hisham from Abdullah bin Jibilla from Muhammad bin Sulayman from al-Ala’ from Muhammad bin Muslim that Abu Ja’far al-Baqir (as) had said: “
The rising of as-Sufyani and the rising of al-Qa’im will be in the same year.”
